name: openlinker
description: Call OpenLinker Agents, expose Codex as a reusable Agent, and use an isolated Browser tool.

interface.shortDescription: Call Agents, serve Codex, use Browser
interface.longDescription: Use local stdio MCP bridges backed by the OpenLinker CLI and SDK to discover callable Agents, run and inspect tasks, explicitly enable Codex as a reliable Runtime Agent with Core-owned conversation and provider-session reuse, or attach a container-isolated Browser Runtime as a client tool. Agent mode and Browser mode are disabled until explicitly configured and never store secrets in plugin configuration.
defaultPrompt: Find an OpenLinker Agent for my task, but do not call it yet.
Run this task with the best matching OpenLinker Agent.
Configure Codex as an OpenLinker Agent, but do not enable it yet.
Explain how to use the isolated Browser tool without starting a browser session.
